claim.quote: These provide the most stringent lower limits to date on the masses for various spin-1 particles, spin-2 gravitons in the Randall--Sundrum model, as well as spin-1 mediators between the SM and dark matter particles.

date.note: arXiv submission date; published as JHEP 07 (2021) 208

name: Most stringent limits on new high-mass dilepton resonances
notes: Numerical mass limits are quoted in the body of the paper, not in the abstract that was fetched, so no key_value is recorded.

significance.note: An exclusion; the paper reports no significant deviation from the standard model.

summary.plain: CMS looked through its whole Run 2 dataset for pairs of electrons or muons from a heavy new particle, found nothing, and so ruled out a wide range of proposed new particles.
summary.technical: Dielectron and dimuon mass spectra from up to 140 fb^-1 of 13 TeV data: no significant deviation from the standard model; limits on narrow spin-1 and spin-2 resonances, dark matter mediators, contact interactions and ADD large extra dimensions, plus a TeV-scale test of lepton flavour universality.

title: Search for resonant and nonresonant new phenomena in high-mass dilepton final states at sqrt(s) = 13 TeV
why_it_matters: High-mass dilepton searches are the cleanest and most far-reaching direct probe of new heavy particles at the LHC; the null result constrains many extensions of the standard model at once.
